gloss: at great length; lengthily; at full length

definitions.gloss: at great length; lengthily; (lying) at full length
definitions.explanation: For a long time or a long stretch, usually longer than the listener would like: talking, explaining, or going on and on. It can also describe a body stretched out at full length, as when lying on a sofa.

examples.japanese: {長々|ながなが}と⟦{失礼|しつれい}しました→失礼する：15203_shitsureisuru⟧。
examples.english: Sorry for going on so long.

examples.japanese: ⟦{校長|こうちょう}→校長：01582_kouchou⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{長々|ながなが}と⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: The principal's speech went on and on.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ソファ→ソファ：04485_sofa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{長々|ながなが}と⟦{寝|ね}そべって→寝そべる：14873_nesoberu⟧、⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}ていた→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: My father was stretched out full length on the sofa, watching TV.

examples.japanese: {長々|ながなが}と⟦{言|い}い{訳|わけ}→言い訳：04653_iiwake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、⟦まず→まず：00796_mazu⟧⟦{素直|すなお}→素直：00391_sunao⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{謝|あやま}った→謝る：01177_ayamaru⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: Rather than making long excuses, you should simply apologize first.

notes:
A reduplicated form of ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧ (long) with the adverbial ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧. It usually carries a faint complaint: the talk or the wait went on longer than needed.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {長々|ながなが}と⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧: to talk at length
- {長々|ながなが}と⟦{説明|せつめい}する→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧: to explain at great length
- {長々|ながなが}と⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: to drag on
- {長々|ながなが}と⟦{失礼|しつれい}しました→失礼する：15203_shitsureisuru⟧: sorry for taking so long (closing a long email or speech)
- {長々|ながなが}と⟦{寝|ね}そべる→寝そべる：14873_nesoberu⟧: to lie stretched out

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{延々|えんえん}→延々：05896_enen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: endlessly — stronger; something that seems never to stop
- ⟦だらだら→だらだら：05843_daradara⟧: sluggishly — drawn out with no focus or energy
